subject: Close date slippage signal — MAP repair & ownership
messages:
From: Emily Tan <emily.tan@acme.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & Close plan

Hi Dylan / Laura,

Quick heads-up from procurement — internal legal and security approvals hit a blocker this morning around data-retention language. It looks like we will miss the original close target (June 4) by ~10–14 business days unless we surface something to the execs this week.

We need: a) an updated mutual action plan showing revised milestones and owners, b) a short evaluation plan that lets our infra team validate throughput within 48–72 hours, and c) a clear list of what still needs signoff (legal, security, procurement).

Can you send a rebaseline and any mitigations you can offer? If Redwood can provision a short dedicated test window for performance validation that would help speed approvals.

Emily
Emily Tan
Director, Cloud Platform
Acme Corp

--
Attachment: acme_procurement_flags.pdf (pdf stub: 45KB)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Emily Tan <emily.tan@acme.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & Close plan

Emily — thanks for the flag and for the specifics. We can take three immediate actions to avoid a multi-week derailment:

1) Rebaseline the MAP with compressed gates — propose moving close to June 18 (two-week buffer). New MAP attached (proposed_map_v2.xlsx).
2) Offer a 72-hour dedicated-capacity trial for Acme to run workload validation (no-cost). We can provision within 24 hours once you sign the form.
3) Provide an SLA-exception packet and a short evaluation checklist so legal/security can see the guardrails we’ll enforce for the trial (attached: redwood_sla_exception_v1.pdf, evaluation_checklist.xlsx).

Immediate asks for you: please confirm which owners are required to re-review (legal contact + security reviewer + procurement PO) so we can route documents directly.

Next steps (my proposal):
- Today (EOD): You confirm the list of outstanding approvers.
- Tomorrow: I’ll share MAP v2 and the dedicated-trial order form.
- Mon/Tue: Technical trial runs, then procurement signoff workflow.

If you prefer, we can also offer a short term credit against first month if procurement needs a financial concession to expedite.

I’ll loop in Karthik to coordinate the trial slots and Laura to escalate if we need exec-level outreach.

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0113

Team — thanks for the context. We should treat this as a high-severity close-risk and move a couple items off the critical path:

Action items (owner / deadline):
- Dylan: publish MAP v2 with explicit approver column and signoff gating by 2027-05-24 17:00 PDT. Include new target close = 2027-06-18.
- Karthik: coordinate the 72-hour dedicated-capacity window; block times and share runbook for Acme infra (2027-05-25).
- Monica (Solutions): prepare a two-page technical note describing data-retention safeguards and where the trial data will be stored, plus a one-page compliance checklist for Acme security (2027-05-25).
- Laura: if procurement / legal push back on the exception, I will coordinate a 30-minute exec bridge with their VP and our Head of Legal on 2027-05-26.

We should also prepare an SLA-exception packet for legal to review (monica + karthik please draft from the template). If we need to sweeten the offer, hold a placeholder for a small onboarding credit (discussed offline).

Tone for external comms: acknowledge the slip, propose the MAP and trial as acceleration levers, and provide a single, clean decision (trial + revised close OR normal timeline). Avoid offering both simultaneously — procurement needs a single clear path.

I’m copying Jason to ensure there are no infra blockers from his side for the trial.

Laura Bennett
Director, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference

Dylan / Laura / Team — thanks for the quick response and clear options. We reviewed MAP v2 and the trial proposal internally. Procurement and legal agreed to a path forward under the following conditions:

- Acme will accept the 72-hour dedicated-capacity trial starting 2027-05-28.
- Redwood must provide the SLA-exception packet and the two-page data-retention note prior to trial start (received).
- Procurement requires the MAP with an approver column and a single final decision on whether we take the trial path (we do).

With those commitments, Acme will target a firm close date of 2027-06-18 (internal calendar updated). This buys us the runway we need for final legal signoff. Please finalize onboarding forms and confirm trial slot by EOD 2027-05-26 so my infra team can schedule the run.

Appreciate the rapid turnaround.

Emily Tan
Director, Cloud Platform
Acme Corp
